from dual;
create view app.v_right(a,b) as select a.id,b.id from app.view_base a right join app.view_other b on a.id=b.id;
create view app.v_full(a,b) as select a.id,b.id from app.view_base a full join app.view_other b on a.id=b.id;
create view app.v_cross(a,b) as select a.id,b.id from app.view_base a cross join app.view_other b;
create view app.v_natural as select id,k,v,s,v2,s2 from app.view_base natural join app.view_other;
create view app.v_recursive(n) as with recursive r(n) as (select 1 union all select n+1 from r where n<3) select n from r;
create view app.v_except as select id from app.view_base except select id from app.view_other;
create view app.v_corresponding(a) as select id a,v b from app.view_base union all corresponding by(a) select id a,v2 c from app.view_other;
create view app.v_corresponding_all(a) as select id a,v b from app.view_base union all corresponding select id a,v2 c from app.view_other;
create view app.v_hierarchy as select id,level lv from app.view_base start with id=1 connect by prior id+1=id;
create view app.v_hierarchy_reverse as select id,level lv from app.view_base connect by nocycle prior id+1=id start with id=1;
create view app.v_top as select top 2 id from app.view_base order by id;
create view app.v_top_percent as select top 50 percent with ties id from app.view_base order by id;
create view app.v_limit as select id from app.view_base order by id limit 2;
create view app.v_limit_offset as select id from app.view_base order by id limit 1,2;
create view app.v_fetch as select id from app.view_base order by id offset 1 rows fetch next 1 rows only;
create view app.v_sample as select id from app.view_base sample(50);
create view app.v_sample_seed as select id from app.view_base sample(50) seed(1);
create view app.v_sample_block as select id from app.view_base sample block(50);
create view app.v_sample_block_seed as select id from app.view_base sample block(50) seed(1);
create view app.v_index_selector as select id from app.view_base index idx_view_base_id where id=1;
create view app.v_part_name as select id from app.view_part partition(p1);
create view app.v_part_for as select id from app.view_part partition for(1);
create view app.v_subpart_name as select id from app.view_subpart subpartition(sp1);
create view app.v_subpart_for as select id from app.view_subpart subpartition for(1,1);
create view app.v_pivot as select * from (select s,v from app.view_base) pivot(sum(v) for s in('A' as a,'B' as b));
create view app.v_unpivot as select * from app.view_wide unpivot(v for s in(a as 'A',b as 'B'));
create view app.v_flashback as select id from app.view_base as of lsn 100;
create view app.v_versions as select id,versions_starttrid from app.view_base versions between lsn 1 and 100;
create view app.v_upd as select id,k,v,s from app.view_base where id>=1;
insert into app.v_upd values(4,44,40,'A');
update app.v_upd set v=41 where id=4;
delete from app.v_upd where id=4;
create view app.v_no_key as select v,s from app.view_base;
update app.v_no_key set s='N' where v=20;
update app.v_right set a=9 where a=1;
update app.v_except set id=9 where id=3;
create view app.v_distinct as select distinct s,v from app.view_base;
update app.v_distinct set v=12 where s='A';
call sp_set_para_value(1,'ENABLE_DIST_VIEW_UPDATE',1);
update app.v_distinct set v=13 where s='A';
call sp_set_para_value(1,'ENABLE_DIST_VIEW_UPDATE',0);
create view app.v_multi(a,b,c) as select x.id,x.v,y.v2 from app.view_base x join app.view_other y on x.id=y.id;
update app.v_multi set b=14 where a=1;
alter session set 'MULTI_UPD_OPT_FLAG'=3;
update app.v_multi set b=15 where a=1;
alter session set 'MULTI_UPD_OPT_FLAG'=1;
create view app.v_parent as select id,k,v,s from app.view_base where v>=10 with check option;
create view app.v_local as select id,k,v,s from app.v_parent where v<=20 with local check option;
insert into app.v_local values(5,55,5,'L');
insert into app.v_local values(7,77,25,'L');
create view app.v_cascaded as select id,k,v,s from app.v_parent where v<=20 with cascaded check option;
insert into app.v_cascaded values(6,66,5,'C');
create view app.v_ro as select id,k,v,s from app.view_base with read only;
insert into app.v_ro values(8,88,80,'R');
update app.v_ro set v=80 where id=1;
delete from app.v_ro where id=1;
merge into app.v_ro d using(select 1 id,11 k,10 v,'A' s) x on(d.id=x.id) when matched then update set d.v=x.v;
comment on view app.v_upd is '';
comment on column app.v_upd.v is '';
comment on view app.v_upd is '';
alter view app.v_upd compile;
create view app.v_replace_parent as select id,v from app.view_base;
create view app.v_replace_child as select id from app.v_replace_parent;
create or replace view app.v_replace_parent as select id,s from app.view_base;
alter session set 'DROP_CASCADE_VIEW'=0;
drop view app.v_dep0_parent restrict;
alter session set 'DROP_CASCADE_VIEW'=1;
drop view app.v_dep1_parent restrict;
drop view app.v_dep1_parent cascade;
alter session set 'DROP_CASCADE_VIEW'=0;
grant create view to app_user;
grant create any view,alter any view,drop any view,select any table to app_any;
grant select,insert,update,delete on app.v_upd to app_viewer with grant option;
revoke select on app.view_base from app_user restrict;
revoke select on app.view_base from app_user cascade;

[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_right(a,b) as select a.id,b.id from app.view_base a right join app.view_other b on a.id=b.id;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_full(a,b) as select a.id,b.id from app.view_base a full join app.view_other b on a.id=b.id;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_cross(a,b) as select a.id,b.id from app.view_base a cross join app.view_other b;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_natural as select id,k,v,s,v2,s2 from app.view_base natural join app.view_other;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_recursive(n) as with recursive r(n) as (select 1 union all select n+1 from r where n<3) select n from r;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_except as select id from app.view_base except select id from app.view_other;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_corresponding(a) as select id a,v b from app.view_base union all corresponding by(a) select id a,v2 c from app.view_other;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_corresponding_all(a) as select id a,v b from app.view_base union all corresponding select id a,v2 c from app.view_other;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_hierarchy as select id,level lv from app.view_base start with id=1 connect by prior id+1=id;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_hierarchy_reverse as select id,level lv from app.view_base connect by nocycle prior id+1=id start with id=1;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_top as select top 2 id from app.view_base order by id;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_top_percent as select top 50 percent with ties id from app.view_base order by id;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_limit as select id from app.view_base order by id limit 2;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_limit_offset as select id from app.view_base order by id limit 1,2;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_fetch as select id from app.view_base order by id offset 1 rows fetch next 1 rows only;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_sample as select id from app.view_base sample(50);
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_sample_seed as select id from app.view_base sample(50) seed(1);
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_sample_block as select id from app.view_base sample block(50);
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_sample_block_seed as select id from app.view_base sample block(50) seed(1);

[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_index_selector as select id from app.view_base index idx_view_base_id where id=1;
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_part_name as select id from app.view_part partition(p1);
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_part_for as select id from app.view_part partition for(1);
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_subpart_name as select id from app.view_subpart subpartition(sp1);
----------
[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_subpart_for as select id from app.view_subpart subpartition for(1,1);

[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create view app.v_pivot as select * from (select s,v from app.view_base) pivot(sum(v) for s in('A' as a,'B' as b));

[CREATE_VIEW(SELECT)] create or replace view app.v_replace_parent as select id,s from app.view_base;

[SESSION_SETTING_WRITE] alter session set 'DROP_CASCADE_VIEW'=0;
----------
[DROP_VIEW] drop view app.v_dep0_parent restrict;
----------
[SESSION_SETTING_WRITE] alter session set 'DROP_CASCADE_VIEW'=1;
----------
[DROP_VIEW] drop view app.v_dep1_parent restrict;
----------
[DROP_VIEW] drop view app.v_dep1_parent cascade;
----------
[SESSION_SETTING_WRITE] alter session set 'DROP_CASCADE_VIEW'=0;
----------
[GRANT] grant create view to app_user;
----------
[GRANT] grant create any view,alter any view,drop any view,select any table to app_any;
----------
[GRANT] grant select,insert,update,delete on app.v_upd to app_viewer with grant option;
----------
[REVOKE] revoke select on app.view_base from app_user restrict;
----------
[REVOKE] revoke select on app.view_base from app_user cascade;
